reviews.title: Great board, worth every penny.
reviews.comment: Awesome motherboard! Paired it with a Ryzen 7 9850x3d and 64gb of ram and a Radeon 9800xt, and it runs Helldivers2 at 150fps easily! Great performance. The bios can be a little clunky to navigate, but it's not a big downside. The case fan and rgb headers were easy to reach, and if planned properly, wire hiding was easy. Install was easy and posted right away, so very happy with this board.
reviews.author: JB

reviews.title: Perfect for gaming
reviews.comment:
This is an excellent motherboard for its price range. It offers solid performance, modern features, and reliable build quality. The only potential downside for hardcore overclockers is its 8+2+2 VRM configuration, which is a bit lower compared to other boards in this segment that offer 12+2+1 or higher. While this won’t be an issue for most users, those planning extreme overclocking may find it somewhat limiting.
That said, for professional gaming, content creation, and everyday heavy use, this board delivers. It comes equipped with PCIe 5.0 support, DDR5 compatibility, WiFi 6, and multiple high-speed USB ports, including USB-C. The BIOS is intuitive and easy to update, and the overall design is sleek and modern, fitting well in most setups.
Another big plus is the range of connectivity options and the strong network performance thanks to the built-in WiFi 6. It also includes good-quality audio components, making it a great choice for gamers or streamers who want solid onboard sound without needing a separate sound card.
Overall, this is a feature-rich, future-proof motherboard that offers great value and performance for gamers and power users who don’t necessarily need the absolute highest-end overclocking capabilities.
reviews.author: Carlos Eduardo Hidalgo Hidalgo

reviews.title: excellent motherboard
reviews.comment:
Looks great, easy to set up and get running. I have been using it daily for nearly 8 months with zero issues. it has been reliable, temps are good and boots fast. The bios is very easy to navigate through. Plenty of customization options.
I've been using gigabyte motherboards since 2012 and will continue to do so.
Currently using this motherboard with a gigabyte 7800 xt windforce and 9800x3d cpu.
reviews.author: nicholas wyatt

reviews.title: Breaks easily/ Stops working and no SPDIF port
reviews.comment: Please do not buy this board. It has been one of the worst boards I have come in contact with. The internet on this thing randomly stopped working after one day of use. I had to bypass it by getting a USB-C to Ethernet adapter for me to get internet again. Also this does NOT have a SPDIF port for common speakers. so buyer beware, please get a different brand or anything else.
reviews.author: Bunny

reviews.title: Works as intended
reviews.comment:
Got it, installed my new 9900X and G.skill flare Xs 96gb DDR5 with it
Swapped over all my old drives. These new power connectors are kind of confusing and the manual doesn't help at all but I eventually figured it out.
Didn't boot. RAM light.
check online, says it wants B slots if only using two sticks of ram, not A1 and A2.
Swap sticks, boots immediately. Set boot drive and RAM speed profile.
Immediately boots to login like my old computer.
Wifi isn't working.
Update bios, use USB-C internet sharing with my phone to download wifi drivers.
Wifi starts working.
Decent number of IO, strong GPU pcie slot, plenty of space between CPU cooler and RAM, WIFI is working perfectly as my old one did at 250mbps.
What more could you want? It works. Been video editing, 3D modeling, gaming, not a single issue in any of these. Motherboards don't get much attention because they don't do much, they ALLOW you to install other components that do much. This one works. Solid price for the chipset too.
